design_note: The original tests inspect financial effects and crash boundaries. This comparison tests the test fixture itself: two generated cases are independent by specification but accidentally share a mutable retry balance. The visible leftover token explains a false failure without blaming the budget implementation.

source.title: API Reference
source.concept: A function-scoped pytest fixture resets once per test, not once for every generated Hypothesis input. Shared mutable fixture state can therefore make a property test unsound.
source.scope: Two fictional generated examples consume tokens from a correct budget implementation. Their intended starting conditions require a fresh budget per example, not a continuous stateful sequence.

lesson.title: A leftover token can make a good rule look broken
lesson.intro: Every generated example must start with 2 retry tokens. Example A consumes 1; independent example B attempts 2 reservations. Compare a shared fixture with a newly constructed budget for each example.

data.input: Independent A uses 1 token; B needs 2; each starts with 2.

left.title: Reuse mutable fixture
steps: A starts with 2 and leaves 1 token
B inherits the same object with 1 token
B's second reservation is denied correctly
left.result: Test setup violates B's required starting condition

right.title: Fresh per example
steps: A starts with 2; discard its remaining 1
Construct B's own budget with 2 tokens
B makes 2 reservations and finishes with 0
right.result: B tests the intended rule without A's residual state

read: The budget implementation behaves consistently in both traces.
The left fixture carries state between examples intended to be independent.
The right fixture restores the declared initial condition for B.
lesson.question: Would suppressing the fixture health check restore B's missing token?
lesson.answer: No. Suppression changes the warning, not object lifetime or state. Create/reset mutable systems inside each independent example. Intentionally stateful testing is different: its generated action sequence must explicitly define shared state and the invariant that spans that sequence.
lesson.takeaway: A property test is only meaningful under its declared initial state.
lesson.assumption: Constructed examples and correct two-token budget; no real provider calls. Independent examples are intentionally distinct from actions inside one stateful test.
